name: Better Net
summary: Tweed Heads/Murwillumbah (NSW) dialup + hosting ISP (Better Net Pty Ltd); acquired by Chariot, site rebranded Chariot netconnect by 2006 (-> TPG).

events.details: Dialup + web hosting; earliest Wayback capture 25 Jan 1998 (better.net.au).
Acquired by Chariot (-> TPG); better.net.au showed Chariot netconnect branding by Jan 2006 and 301-redirected to www.chariot.net.au by Feb 2007.

ACN 003 868 120 previously cited for this ISP is a name collision: on ABR it is BETTER NETWORK SERVICES GROUP PTY. LTD. (trading as BNS GROUP), an ACT company registered 11 Mar 2000 and still active, unrelated to this NSW dialup ISP.
